Name: Bartending Emily and Corine
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
This mod gives equal chances who will take your order for those who work behind the counter: Gus, Emily and Corine. Ridgeside not required!

Refreshes every click! I play with over 250 mods and didn't have performance issues. As you can see in the pictures, tested on a Friday where all three were present, I asked my order multiple times at 7PM, and tested on a Thursday where Emily and Gus took my order, all with random dialogues.

Also potentially opens the saloon until 2AM, depending if any of these 3 npcs is behind the counter. Which means, for example when Gus goes to bed at 12AM, Emily could still take your order as long as she is behind the counter.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Thanks to BETAS, you can look for NPCs in a certain area on a map, for example these three characters behind the counter in the Saloon!
The mod does not require RSV!
Compatible with seasonal outfits and stuff (see pictures of Emily).
Can be installed or uninstalled at any point. Can also install RSV midgame without problems in any order.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
I took Gus' 4 random lines for Emily and Corine, maybe they should get their own lines? Maybe even extra lines if you are dating Emily/Corine...
I don't think changing the chances will be necessary as you can click the counter and escape as often as you can on an evening.
I also don't think I will need to improve the performance, random every click sounds heavy but it seems to run completely fine for me.
Another modded NPC, Quinn, goes behind the bar after 12 to talk with Emily, could be funny to add a small chance for her after 12 as an easter egg, but their permissions are not open.
